video_title: God Shammgod on How Hooping With Ma$e & Cam’ron Shaped His Game and Getting Robbed at Gunpoint

quotes.speaker: God Shammgod
quotes.summary_phrase: God Shammgod on his draft night prediction about Cam'ron
quotes.excerpt: I had told the Wizards I was like, yo, somebody in my hood that's better than me.
quotes.quote: I remember on draft night I got drafted and I had told the Wizards I was like, yo, somebody in my hood that's better than me, that's 6'9, I can do everything I can do. And they were like, no way. And I was like, I'm telling you. His name is Cam'ron. This is before all the Cam'ron stuff. I was like, his name is Cam'ron. And they were like, so why we never heard of him? I'm like, we just had two different paths, but I'm telling you.
quotes.social_post: God Shammgod says he told the Wizards on draft night that Cam'ron was a better basketball player than him. He claims Cam'ron had the talent to be a 6'9 star if he had taken a different path.
quotes.team: Cousins with Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady

quotes.speaker: God Shammgod
quotes.summary_phrase: God Shammgod on the difference between himself and Cam'ron
quotes.excerpt: They were at the same place in life at one time, but Cam'ron had Ron Leclear.
quotes.quote: The only difference between me and Cam'ron that people don't know is they were at the same place in life at one time, both in the street playing basketball. But Cam'ron had Ron Leclear, and I didn't have no one that's like to push him. Cam'ron had Ron Leclear, which in a couple other people that was like, yeah, you got to go to college, you got to go to Fresno State, got to go this, got to do this.
quotes.social_post: God Shammgod reflects on the different paths he and Cam'ron took, noting that Cam'ron had the support system to push him toward college basketball while he had to navigate his own way.
quotes.team: Cousins with Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady

quotes.speaker: God Shammgod
quotes.summary_phrase: God Shammgod on his early basketball development at Manhattan Center
quotes.excerpt: I was going to Manhattan Center because of Ma$e and Cam'ron.
quotes.quote: When I was in the eighth grade, before I went to La Salle, I was going to Manhattan Center because of Ma$e and Cam'ron. This is how special, how good Cam was. I was like, oh yeah, I'm going. Cam went there, I'm going there. Like this is how Cam was. Cam was like, you know, Cam was always nice. But he was a sophomore. So they used to bring me to the school. I come up there, hang out. It was Ma$e, Cam'ron, and then the next year my boy Richie Parker went there.
quotes.social_post: Before he was a legend, God Shammgod says he was just a kid following Ma$e and Cam'ron around Manhattan Center. He says Cam'ron was always that guy even back in high school.
quotes.team: Cousins with Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady

quotes.speaker: God Shammgod
quotes.summary_phrase: God Shammgod on Ma$e's defensive game in high school
quotes.excerpt: Ma$e was more like the NBA version of Pat Bev.
quotes.quote: Ma$e was good in basketball, but Ma$e was more like the NBA version of Pat Bev. Like the defensive guy, the more of an agitator. So that was Ma$e. He was the defensive guy, the more of an agitator.
quotes.social_post: God Shammgod compares Ma$e's high school basketball game to Patrick Beverley, calling him the defensive agitator of their group.
quotes.team: Cousins with Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady

quotes.speaker: God Shammgod
quotes.summary_phrase: God Shammgod on how Ma$e helped him develop his handle
quotes.excerpt: Ma$e used to come get me every day in the morning and just play defense on me.
quotes.quote: Ma$e used to come get me every day in the morning, going to my 10th grade year, and just play defense on me while I worked on my handle. Every morning he would pick me up and just guard me. The whole workout, just guard me, nothing else, just guard me.
quotes.social_post: God Shammgod credits Ma$e for helping him develop his legendary handle, saying Ma$e would pick him up every morning just to play defense on him for the entire workout.
quotes.team: Cousins with Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady

quotes.speaker: God Shammgod
quotes.summary_phrase: God Shammgod on Ma$e's musical and cultural impact
quotes.excerpt: Ma$e was in the era with Biggie, Tupac, and it was Ma$e.
quotes.quote: Ma$e was in the era with Biggie, Tupac, and it was Ma$e. And Ma$e had his own lane from Biggie and Tupac. Like everybody that was at that age, 19 and under, was Ma$e. And the only person that could come close to that probably was Bow Wow at that point in that era, as far as existing, coexisting with those people. And Ma$e blew up so fast and he put Harlem on the map so quick.
quotes.social_post: God Shammgod discusses the cultural impact of Ma$e, noting how he blew up and put Harlem on the map during the era of Biggie and Tupac.
quotes.team: Cousins with Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady

quotes.speaker: God Shammgod
quotes.summary_phrase: God Shammgod on getting robbed at gunpoint with Ma$e
quotes.excerpt: A dude came out, he's kind of Spanish, he's like, man, y'all got change for a dollar?
quotes.quote: We stop at a store and I'll never forget, a dude came out, he's kind of Spanish, and he's like, man, y'all got change for a dollar? It's like, no, change for a dollar, what you talking about? He pull out a gun. He pointed at me and he's like, you better give up all your stuff, talking to Ma$e, because Ma$e got Rolex on, he got chain on. I'm going to shoot him. And Ma$e is like, he's wearing a clip, but Ma$e is bugged out. So Ma$e looking, he looking at me like, well, he really got you. He really wants that me.
quotes.social_post: God Shammgod shares a wild story about getting robbed at gunpoint with Ma$e, recalling how Ma$e was bugged out while the gunman targeted them for their jewelry.
